title: Review revenue recognition and deferred revenue
summary: When customer contracts create timing, allocation or uncertainty questions beyond collecting payment. A reviewed accounting policy and contract-level revenue schedule reconciled to the ledger and remaining performance obligations.
outcomes: A reviewed accounting policy and contract-level revenue schedule reconciled to the ledger and remaining performance obligations.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When customer contracts create timing, allocation or uncertainty questions beyond collecting payment.

parts.title: Collect contracts and delivery evidence
parts.guidance: Gather signed agreements, amendments, invoices, credits and evidence of goods or services delivered. Identify bundled promises, variable fees and unusual acceptance terms for professional review.

references.title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers overview

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Determine the applicable accounting framework
parts.guidance: The qualified accounting owner confirms the governing framework and contract treatment. This guide uses an IFRS overview as a reference and does not impose IFRS rules on entities using another framework.

references.title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers overview

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Prepare the contract analysis and schedule
parts.guidance: Draft a contract-level schedule of promises, pricing assumptions, delivery dates and proposed recognition. Label judgments and distinguish cash collection, invoicing and recognized revenue.

references.title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers overview

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Review judgments and approve the accounting treatment
parts.guidance: The accounting owner reviews allocations, estimates, progress measures and contract changes under the applicable framework. Record support for judgments and escalate material uncertainty before posting.

references.title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers overview

parts.title: Post approved entries through accounting controls
parts.guidance: Authorized finance operators post the reviewed entries and retain approvals and source links. Reconcile recognized and deferred balances to the contract schedule and investigate differences.

parts.title: Verify the close and refresh estimates
parts.guidance: The accounting owner reviews balances, remaining obligations and disclosure needs. Record changes in estimates and exceptions, with evidence for the next reporting close.
